paper_metadata.title: Study of the influence of Zr on the mechanical properties and functional response of Ti-Nb-Ta-Zr-O alloy for orthopedic applications

evidence.quote: The present study attempts to investigate the influence of Zr on the overall mechanical and functional responses of a Ti -Nb-Ta-Zr-O alloy in contrast to a new Ti -Nb-Ta-O alloy.
The two alloys, with compositions of Ti -34Nb-2Ta-3Zr-0.5O (wt.%) and Ti -34Nb-2Ta-0.5O (wt.%), were cast by vacuum arc melting using a Tungsten electrode arc furnace.
